title: Room Presence v1
description: Presence event for a room — who joined, left, focused, blurred, or is currently active. Emitted by the room UI (notebook-workbench, creator-canvas-primary) and by P7 when an agent session enters or leaves the room. Consumed by the room sidebar to render the active collaborator list.

room_id.description: Room manifest identifier the presence event refers to.

presence_id.description: Unique id for this presence event. Enables dedup if the same event is published by multiple surfaces.

session_id.description: Optional P7 room session id. Null when presence happens outside an active session.

actor.description: User handle, agent name, or service identifier the presence event is about.

actor_kind.description: Classifies the actor. user = a human, agent = an AI agent session, service = a background process (e.g. pinokio-bridge).

action.description: What the actor did. focus/blur are tab- or window-level. active/idle are coarse heartbeat states.

surface.description: Optional room surface the action is scoped to (e.g. notebook-workbench, comfy-collab). Null when surface-agnostic.

actor_metadata.description: Optional actor context (model_id, device, user_agent, etc.). Free-form.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the presence event was observed.
